1981-2034-2415-5332.description:
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing a creature, adding {C}{C}
When the creature dies, Carmen and Havoc Jester trigger.
Resolve the Carmen trigger, causing you to gain 1 life and put a +1/+1 counter on Carmen
Resolve the Havoc Jester trigger, dealing 1 damage to you.
Darien triggers, creating a 1/1 Soldier creature token.
Repeat.

uses.battlefieldCardState: as a copy of Radiant Solar
as a copy of Radiant Solar

670-1619-1974-3388.easyPrerequisites:
You have a way to cause a creature to enter the battlefield under your control.
You are not currently venturing in a dungeon.
670-1619-1974-3388.description:
Put any nontoken creature onto the battlefield.
When the creature enters, Radiant Solar, Quicksilver Gargantuan and Moritte of the Frost each trigger.
Resolve the Radiant Solar trigger, causing you to venture into Tomb of Annihilation and into the Trapped Entry room, causing each player to lose 1 life.
Resolve the Quicksilver Gargantuan trigger, venturing into the Oubliette room, causing you to discard a card and then sacrifice Radiant Solar.
Resolve the Moritte of the Frost trigger, venturing into the Cradle of the Death God room, creating a 4/4 legendary The Atropal creature token and completing Tomb of Annihilation.
If you control two or more The Atropal tokens, put all but one into your graveyard due to the legend rule.
Sefris' second ability triggers, returning Radiant Solar from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat from step 2.
670-1619-1974-3388.notes: If you are currently venturing in a dungeon when starting the combo, you can complete the dungeon and then use Sefris' second ability to put a creature onto the battlefield to start the combo.

215-3443-3480.notablePrerequisites: You have at least seven creature cards in your graveyard.
215-3443-3480.description:
Activate Deathbloom Ritualist by tapping it, adding an amount of {B} or {G}.
Activate Temur Sabertooth by paying {1}{G}, returning Deathbloom Ritualist from the battlefield to your hand.
Cast Deathbloom Ritualist by paying its mana cost.
Repeat.
215-3443-3480.notes: Alternate the colors of mana you add each time. If you start adding {B}, you need {G} for Temur Sabertooth and {G} to cast Deathbloom Ritualist

1368-4289-5223-6321.notablePrerequisites: You have at least three other cards in your graveyard.
1368-4289-5223-6321.description:
Cast Malevolent Rumble for its escape cost by paying {1}{G} and exiling three other cards from your graveyard, causing you to mill at least three cards and create a 0/1 Eldrazi Spawn creature token.
Activate the Eldrazi Spawn by tapping it, adding {G}.
Activate the Eldrazi Spawn by sacrificing it, adding {C}.
Repeat.

109-4036-7497.description:
Cast Wisdom of Ages by paying {4}{U}{U}{U}.
Holding priority, cast Seething Song by paying {2}{R}, adding {R}{R}{R}{R}{R}.
Holding priority, cast Fork by paying {R}{R}, copying Wisdom of Ages.
Resolve the copy of Wisdom of Ages, returning all instant and sorcery cards from your graveyard to your hand.
Repeat from step 2.

3967-4907-6556-6989.notablePrerequisites: You control at least three creatures with power 4 or greater.
3967-4907-6556-6989.description:
Cast Tatterkite from your graveyard by paying {0} due to Temur Battlecrier. It won't enter with a finality counter on it due to its static ability.
Activate Yahenni by sacrificing Tatterkite.
Repeat.

2281-6798-6909.easyPrerequisites: It is your precombat main phase.
2281-6798-6909.description:
Cast Carnage by paying {2}{B}{R}. 
When Carnage enters, it triggers, returning Saffi from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Activate Saffi by sacrificing it, targeting Carnage.
Activate Umbral Collar Zealot by sacrificing Carnage.
When Carnage dies, Saffi triggers, returning Carnage from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Carnage enters, it triggers, returning Saffi from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Resolve the Umbral Collar Zealot ability.
Repeat from step 3.

414-1453-4613.easyPrerequisites: You control a creature that has a +1/+1 counter on it.
414-1453-4613.description:
Activate a creature using Grist's first loyalty ability by putting a loyalty counter on it, causing you to create a 1/1 Insect creature token and mill a card, and then put a loyalty counter on the creature and repeat the process if the card was an Insect.
The Insect enters the battlefield with a +1/+1 counter on it due to Arwen, causing it to have Grist's abilities.
Repeat from step 1 using the Insect token instead.

2079-2366-3430-5702.easyPrerequisites:
You have a land card in hand.
You are able to play a land this turn.
2079-2366-3430-5702.description:
Play a land. When the land enters, Springheart Nantuko triggers, causing you to pay {1}{G} to create a token copy of Dryad Arbor.
When the Dryad Arbor token enters, Springheart Nantuko triggers. Holding priority, activate the Dryad Arbor token by tapping it, adding {G}{G}{G} due to Nyxbloom Ancient.
Resolve the Springheart Nantuko trigger, causing you to pay {1}{G} to create a token copy of Dryad Arbor.
Repeat from step 2.

821-2173-4446-5220.notablePrerequisites: You control at least one Cleric
821-2173-4446-5220.description:
Activate Mogg Fanatic by sacrificing it.
When Mogg Fanatic dies, Mortuary and Relic Vial trigger.
Resolve the Mortuary trigger, putting Mogg Fanatic from your graveyard onto the top of your library.
Resolve the Relic Vial trigger, causing you to gain 1 life and each opponent to lose 1 life.
Resolve the Mogg Fanatic ability.
Cast Mogg Fanatic from the top of your library by paying 1 life.
Repeat.

uses.battlefieldCardState: attached to a creature you control

1987-4045-4423-5243.description:
Activate Mystic Sanctuary and Ur-Golem's Eye by tapping them, adding {C}{C}{U}.
Cast Ghostly Flicker either from your hand or from the top of your library by paying {2}{U}, blinking Mystic Sanctuary and Ur-Golem's Eye.
When Mystic Sanctuary enters untapped, it triggers, putting Ghostly Flicker from your graveyard onto the top of your library.
Repeat.

1879-2457-4289-6753.description:
Activate Ant Queen by paying {1}{G}, creating two 1/1 Insect creature tokens.
Activate two Insects by tapping them, adding {1}{G}.
Repeat

198-803-3767-3918.manaNeeded: {1} if Trazyn doesn't have a charge counter on it
198-803-3767-3918.easyPrerequisites: Trazyn the Infinite does not have summoning sickness.
198-803-3767-3918.notablePrerequisites: Arcane Adaptation on the battlefield with "Sliver" chosen.
198-803-3767-3918.description:
Activate Trazyn using Empowered Autogenerator's ability by tapping it, putting a charge counter on Trazyn and adding one mana of any color for each charge counter on Trazyn.
Activate Trazyn by paying {2}, untapping it.
Repeat.

372-2493-4598.notablePrerequisites:
You have any number of other nonland permanents that enter the battlefield untapped, and that can collectively tap to produce enough mana to cast Essence Flux exiled by Abdel Adrian.
Archaeomancer exiled by Abdel Adrian.
You have enough mana to cast Essence Flux.
372-2493-4598.description:
Cast Essence Flux by paying its mana cost, blinking Abdel Adrian.
Abdel Adrian leaves the battlefield, returning Archaeomancer and all other cards that were exiled with it to the battlefield.
Abdel Adrian and Archaeomancer trigger.
Resolve the Archaeomancer trigger, returning Essence Flux from your graveyard to your hand.
Holding priority, activate any number of nonland permanents you control by tapping them, adding at least enough mana to cast Essence Flux.
Resolve the Abdel Adrian trigger, exiling Archaeomancer and the mana-producing permanents until Abdel Adrian leaves the battlefield, and creating a 1/1 Soldier creature token for each permanent exiled this way.
Repeat.

5256-5805--5.notablePrerequisites: At least one opponent has lost life this turn.
5256-5805--5.description:
Activate Altar of Dementia by sacrificing the creature with persist.
The persist ability triggers, returning that creature to the battlefield with a -1/-1 counter on it, as well as a +1/+1 counter due to Gev.
The +1/+1 and -1/-1 counters on that creature are removed as a state-based action.
Resolve the ability from step 1, milling target player a number of cards equal to the sacrificed creature's power.
Repeat.

2178-2857-2921.easyPrerequisites: Thornbite Staff attached to Adarkar Valkyrie.
2178-2857-2921.notablePrerequisites: Adarkar Valkyrie does not have summoning sickness. You control at least one additional nontoken creature.
2178-2857-2921.description:
Activate Adarkar Valkyrie by tapping it, targeting another nontoken creature you control.
Activate Bartolomé del Presidio by sacrificing the creature targeted in step 1.
When the creature dies, Adarkar Valkyrie triggers twice.
Resolve the first trigger, untapping Adarkar Valkyrie.
Resolve the second trigger, returning the sacrificed creature from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Resolve the Bartolomé del Presidio ability, putting a +1/+1 counter on it.
Repeat.

2440-2645-5917.notablePrerequisites:
You control at least one additional nonlegendary creature.
You control at least four creatures that are either Balloons or that share a creature type with the nonlegendary creature.
2440-2645-5917.description:
Activate The Jolly Balloon Man by paying {1} and tapping it, creating a token copy of a nonlegendary creature you control that is a 1/1 Balloon with flying and haste.
When the creature token enters the battlefield, Mana Echoes triggers, adding {C} for creature you control that shares a creature type with the creature token.
Activate Staff of Domination's third ability by paying {3} and tapping it, untapping The Jolly Balloon Man.
Activate Staff of Domination's first ability by paying {1}, untapping it.
Repeat.

1012-2034-2208-4230.description:
Cast Charming Scoundrel either from your hand or from the top of your library by paying {2}.
When Charming Scoundrel enters the battlefield, it triggers, creating a Wicked Role token attached to it.
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing Charming Scoundrel, adding {2}.
Charming Scoundrel is returned to your hand instead of being put into your graveyard due to Necromancer's Magemark.
The Wicked Role token that was attached to Charming Scoundrel triggers, causing each opponent to lose 1 life.
Repeat.

575-2256-4050.description:
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing Dulcet Sirens, adding {U}.
When Dulcet Sirens dies, Yedora triggers, returning Dulcet Sirens from your graveyard to the battlefield face down as a Forest land.
Activate Dulcet Sirens by tapping it, adding {G}.
Activate Dulcet Sirens's morph ability by paying {U}, turning it face up.
Repeat.

851-1651-4330.notablePrerequisites: You control a creature that has fought this turn.
851-1651-4330.description:
Activate Boxing Ring by tapping it, creating two Treasure artifact tokens.
Activate Clock of Omens by tapping the Treasures, untapping Boxing Ring.
Repeat.

1636-2952-5251.notablePrerequisites:
Sorcerer's Wand attached to Emmara.
Emmara does not have summoning sickness.
1636-2952-5251.description:
Activate Emmara by tapping it, dealing 1 damage to target player or planeswalker.
Emmara triggers, creating a 1/1 Human Warrior creature token.
The Human Warrior enters the battlefield, triggering Intruder Alarm, untapping all creatures.
Repeat.

1030-2034-2608.notablePrerequisites: Othelm does not have summoning sickness.
1030-2034-2608.description:
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing Derevi, adding {C}{C}.
Activate Othelm by paying {2} and tapping it, returning Derevi from your graveyard to the battlefield tapped.
Derevi enters the battlefield, untapping Othelm.
Repeat.

2713-4499-4617.description:
Activate Soulbright Flamekin 3 times for {3} total to give 3 targets trample.
When the ability resolves for the third time, add 8 {R}.
Pay {1} to activate Emiel, exiling SoulBright Flamekin and then returning it to the battlefield.
Repeat for infinite {R}.
